title: A Lantern for the Bridge
author: Petra Oyelaran
blurb: Hazel Vane, a typeface cutter's daughter in a print shop on the eve of a revolution, measures the world in what can be carried when the orders come. But when the census taker asks one question too many, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, she must choose which family member gets the last berth before the century turns.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
